MODEL-FIRST OWNED INITIAL CONSTRUCTION — 2026-10-24
Preserved before any sibling prompt/proposal exposure. Actual assignment is
../PROMPT_MODEL_FIRST.txt and shared upstream need is ../SHARED_BRIEF.txt.
This is an owned construction plus obstruction, not a demonstrated catalyst.

Operation and exact stoichiometry
Let A and B be recoverable ligand-supported metal fragments with nitrogen-free
states A(III), B(III) and nitrido states A(VI)N, B(VI)N. Mo(III)/Mo(VI) is the
first physically grounded family to examine because low-coordinate Mo(III)
can split N2 and molecular Mo-to-Mo nitrido transfer has actual precedent.
Formal states are bookkeeping; a real ligand set and spin states must be acquired.

1. 2 A(III) + N2 -> 2 A(VI)N.
2. A(VI)N + B(III) -> A(III) + B(VI)N, twice per N2.
3. B(VI)N + (3/2) H2 -> B(III) + NH3, twice per N2.
Net: N2 + 3 H2 -> 2 NH3. Water electrolysis supplying the 3 H2 adds
3 H2O -> 3 H2 + (3/2) O2; total N2+3 H2O -> 2 NH3+(3/2) O2.
If instead electrons/protons are used, all acid/base buffers, counterions and
anodic reaction must close: N2+6H+ +6e- ->2NH3 plus a specified water anode.
No SmI2, Li, phosphine, hydride or ligand may be credited as regenerated
merely because a transition metal turns over.

Proposed redox/coordination gate
A ligand state g=0 favors N2 activation; g=1 destabilizes A-N relative to empty
A so that contact with B can transfer N. Reversible electrochemical charge or
reversible binding of one specified ligand may implement the gate. The ligand
and its reservoir must be restored. B may have a second gate h favoring NHx
formation and ammonia release. There is no free adsorbed N atom between sites:
the transfer coordinate includes an A-(mu-N)-B bridge and cleavage to products.
This means precursor association, bridging-state trapping, electron/spin change,
and A/B separation are part of the actual barrier, not favorable inputs.

Thermodynamic obstruction derived before material selection
At fixed T and feed/product chemical potentials define, per transferred N,
 b_A^g=G(A_N^g)-G(A_empty^g)-(1/2)mu_N2,
 b_B^h=G(B_N^h)-G(B_empty^h)-(1/2)mu_N2,
 d=mu_NH3-(1/2)mu_N2-(3/2)mu_H2.
With fixed gates, capture, transfer and hydrogenation free energies are b_A,
 b_B-b_A, d-b_B. Their sum is d. All three downhill requires exactly
 d <= b_B <= b_A <= 0. If d>=0 the passive downhill window is empty

MODEL-FIRST CONSTRUCTION / OBSTRUCTION CHECKPOINT — 2026-10-24

Result at this checkpoint

The proposed class can be written as a chemically closed operation, and real
nitrogen transfer is possible. It has not produced a new demonstrated operation
or a competitive renewable-ammonia process here. A central correction is that
nitrogen handoff to a hydrogenating carrier is already an established research
route: TM-nitride/LiH/amide catalysis and nitride–imide chemical loops are strong
incumbents. What remains specifically unacquired in the molecular construction
is dehydrogenative transfer of N2-derived Mo nitride to a real hydrogenating
receiver, with all of the receiver's stored H and ligand protonation restored.

The original fictitious B(III) bookkeeping has therefore been replaced below
by actual Ru–PNP nitrido/polyhydride species. This exposes both a physical
transfer barrier and a pressure/regeneration cost that the simple sketch hid.
It also yields a sharp isotope experiment distinguishing N handoff from an
ordinary H-delivery catalyst. No favorable central-transfer rate is supplied.

1. A chemically specified A/B candidate, with complete stoichiometry

Set Ar=3,5-Me2C6H3 and L= N(tBu)Ar (an anionic amido ligand).
 A = MoL3, the low-coordinate Mo(III) N2-cleaving fragment;
 AN = NMoL3, the corresponding terminal Mo(VI) nitride.
The actual N2-splitting family is documented by Laplaza/Cummins,
Science1995 DOI10.1126/science.268.5212.861 and mechanistic JACS1996
DOI10.1021/ja960574x. The 2024 primary below discusses these exact fragments.

Let PNP = N(CH2CH2PtBu2)2, an anionic amido pincer, and HPNP its neutral
amine form. Use these actual receiver-family states:
 BN = RuN(PNP);
 B3 = RuH3(PNP);
 B5 = RuH4(HPNP).
The labels 3/5 count total stored H atoms outside fixed PNP skeleton; B5 has
four hydrides plus the pincer N–H. These are not interchangeable empty sites.
Askevold etal NatureChem2011 DOI10.1038/nchem.1051 reports Ru-nitride
hydrogenolysis. The corresponding author's primary thesis section
https://mediatum.ub.tum.de/download/1106483/1106483.pdf (printed p96)
explicitly identifies B5 as the product and small equilibrium amounts of B3
under H2. Primary-source excerpt reports about85% B5 and >80% NH3 after
48h at50C under1bar H2, with isotope NMR evidence for nitrido-N becoming NH3.

POST-REVIEW CLARIFICATION OF THE FROZEN MODEL-FIRST CHECKPOINT
2026-10-24. Added after authorized peer exposure; original checkpoint unchanged.

Root relayed the open-arm reviewer's correct quantization challenge:
AN+B3 -> A+BN+(3/2)H2 is balanced per nitrogen equivalent, but is not one
isolated elementary bimolecular reaction of two intact molecules. B3 stores
three H atoms; producing1.5 isolated H2 molecules requires an even number of
such turnovers or an explicit reversible odd-H storage intermediate.

The integer formula-level reaction is
 2AN+2B3 -> 2A+2BN+3H2.
Together with two known-family BN+4H2->B5+NH3 and two formal B5->B3+H2
steps it retains the same N2+3H2->2NH3 external sum after N2 cleavage.
The macroscopic gas balance and2.5RTln(phigh/plow) per-NH3 chosen-swing
work remain valid. They do not supply the microscopic reaction order.

The frozen checkpoint's generic bridge association AN+B<->I can be
bimolecular. Its following k_T completion edge is a lumped rate; for the
specific RuH3 receiver it cannot be assigned an intrinsic first-order or
isolated two-body atom-transfer barrier without resolving the odd-H fate.
A possible expanded bookkeeping would require a real H-storage state XH:
 I+X -> A+BN+H2+XH,
 2XH -> 2X+H2.
Here X/XH is an unacquired physical carrier and adds its own kinetics,
state energies and regeneration. This notation is not a proposed material,
does not license a favorable free-H atom, and does not establish those steps.
An interacting pair of bridge complexes is another possible expansion but
would require its own measured/calculated cooperative path. The paired
formula cannot simply be treated as an elementary fourth-order process.

Thus the candidate's central missing operation is stricter than a nominal
Mo-to-Ru N-transfer rate: acquire N relocation, Mo recovery AND an
integer-H-resolved dehydrogenation/recombination mechanism. The site-specific
15N crossover remains useful and should also quantify H2/HD/D2 and any
H-storage species. Observing Ru15N alone would establish relocation, not
complete regeneration of the H inventory. The Eyring target bounds in
cycle_gate_checks.py apply only conditionally to a genuinely specified
elementary bottleneck, not to this unacquired coarse T reaction.
